guidance: Control outbound VPC traffic to prevent communication with malicious URLs, IPs, or unauthorized tunnels. Two primary options: Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall (deny-by-default for all domains except trusted ones, easy to deploy via Firewall Manager) and AWS Network Firewall (L3-L7 inspection including east-west traffic). For web-only workloads, WAF may suffice. Use AWS PrivateLink for private partner connectivity. Forward firewall/proxy logs to your SIEM for Shadow IT detection.
how_to_check: Is outbound VPC traffic restricted to known destinations? Is Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall deployed with a deny-by-default policy? Is AWS Network Firewall or equivalent in place for L3-L7 inspection? Are firewall logs forwarded to a SIEM? For more information, please refer to the documentation.
